# plsRbeta

# Partial Least Squares Regression for Beta Regression Models

## Frédéric Bertrand and Myriam Maumy-Bertrand

<https://doi.org/10.32614/CRAN.package.plsRbeta>

The goal of plsRbeta is to provide Partial least squares Regression for
(weighted) beta regression models (Bertrand 2013,
<https://ojs-test.apps.ocp.math.cnrs.fr/index.php/J-SFdS/article/view/215>)
and k-fold cross-validation of such models using various criteria. It
allows for missing data in the explanatory variables. Bootstrap
confidence intervals constructions are also available.

The package was accepted for presentation at the the useR! 2021
international conference. A technical note for the package was created
and published on the website of the conference. It can be accessed here:
<https://user2021.r-project.org/participation/technical_notes/t138/technote/>.
It is not only an english translation of most of the contents of the
original article that was published in French but it also contains the R
code reproduce the two examples that were presented in the article.

This website and these examples were created by F. Bertrand and M.
Maumy-Bertrand.

## Installation

You can install the released version of plsRbeta from
[CRAN](https://CRAN.R-project.org) with:

``` r
install.packages("plsRbeta")
```

You can install the development version of plsRbeta from
[github](https://github.com) with:

``` r
devtools::install_github("fbertran/plsRbeta")
```

## Example

### Using a model matrix

Fit a plsRbeta model using a model matrix.

``` r
data("GasolineYield",package="betareg")
yGasolineYield <- GasolineYield$yield
XGasolineYield <- GasolineYield[,2:5]
library(plsRbeta)
modpls <- plsRbeta(yGasolineYield,XGasolineYield,nt=3,modele="pls-beta")
#> ____************************************************____
#> 
#> Model: pls-beta 
#> 
#> Link: logit 
#> 
#> Link.phi: 
#> 
#> Type: ML 
#> 
#> ____Component____ 1 ____
#> ____Component____ 2 ____
#> ____Component____ 3 ____
#> ____Predicting X without NA neither in X nor in Y____
#> ****________________________________________________****
print(modpls)
#> Number of required components:
#> [1] 3
#> Number of successfully computed components:
#> [1] 3
#> Coefficients:
#>                   [,1]
#> Intercept -3.324462301
#> gravity    0.001577508
#> pressure   0.072027686
#> temp10    -0.008398771
#> temp       0.010365973
#> Information criteria and Fit statistics:
#>                  AIC        BIC Chi2_Pearson_Y
#> Nb_Comp_0  -52.77074  -49.83927       30.72004
#> Nb_Comp_1 -112.87383 -108.47662       30.57369
#> Nb_Comp_2 -136.43184 -130.56889       30.97370
#> Nb_Comp_3 -139.08440 -131.75572       31.08224
#>                RSS_Y pseudo_R2_Y      R2_Y
#> Nb_Comp_0 0.35640772          NA        NA
#> Nb_Comp_1 0.05211039   0.8498691 0.8537900
#> Nb_Comp_2 0.02290022   0.9256771 0.9357471
#> Nb_Comp_3 0.02022386   0.9385887 0.9432564
```

Additionnal values can be retrieved from the fitted model.

``` r
modpls$pp
#>             Comp_ 1    Comp_ 2    Comp_ 3
#> gravity   0.4590380 -0.4538663 -2.5188256
#> pressure  0.6395524 -0.4733525  0.6488823
#> temp10   -0.5435643  0.5292108 -1.3295905
#> temp      0.5682795  0.5473174 -0.2156423
modpls$Coeffs
#>                   [,1]
#> Intercept -3.324462301
#> gravity    0.001577508
#> pressure   0.072027686
#> temp10    -0.008398771
#> temp       0.010365973
modpls$Std.Coeffs
#>                   [,1]
#> Intercept -1.547207760
#> gravity    0.008889933
#> pressure   0.188700277
#> temp10    -0.315301400
#> temp       0.723088387
modpls$InfCrit
#>                  AIC        BIC Chi2_Pearson_Y      RSS_Y pseudo_R2_Y      R2_Y
#> Nb_Comp_0  -52.77074  -49.83927       30.72004 0.35640772          NA        NA
#> Nb_Comp_1 -112.87383 -108.47662       30.57369 0.05211039   0.8498691 0.8537900
#> Nb_Comp_2 -136.43184 -130.56889       30.97370 0.02290022   0.9256771 0.9357471
#> Nb_Comp_3 -139.08440 -131.75572       31.08224 0.02022386   0.9385887 0.9432564
modpls$PredictY[1,]
#>   gravity  pressure    temp10      temp 
#>  2.049533  1.686655 -1.371820 -1.821977
rm("modpls")
```

\###Formula support

Fit a plsRbeta model using formula support.

``` r
data("GasolineYield",package="betareg")
modpls <- plsRbeta(yield~.,data=GasolineYield,nt=3,modele="pls-beta", verbose=FALSE)
print(modpls)
#> Number of required components:
#> [1] 3
#> Number of successfully computed components:
#> [1] 3
#> Coefficients:
#>                    [,1]
#> Intercept -4.1210566077
#> gravity    0.0157208676
#> pressure   0.0305159627
#> temp10    -0.0074167766
#> temp       0.0108057945
#> batch1     0.0910284843
#> batch2     0.1398537354
#> batch3     0.2287070465
#> batch4    -0.0008124326
#> batch5     0.1018679027
#> batch6     0.1147971957
#> batch7    -0.1005469609
#> batch8    -0.0447907428
#> batch9    -0.0706292318
#> batch10   -0.1984703429
#> Information criteria and Fit statistics:
#>                  AIC        BIC Chi2_Pearson_Y
#> Nb_Comp_0  -52.77074  -49.83927       30.72004
#> Nb_Comp_1  -87.96104  -83.56383       31.31448
#> Nb_Comp_2 -114.10269 -108.23975       33.06807
#> Nb_Comp_3 -152.71170 -145.38302       30.69727
#>                RSS_Y pseudo_R2_Y      R2_Y
#> Nb_Comp_0 0.35640772          NA        NA
#> Nb_Comp_1 0.11172576   0.6879757 0.6865226
#> Nb_Comp_2 0.04650238   0.8671800 0.8695248
#> Nb_Comp_3 0.01138837   0.9526757 0.9680468
```

Additionnal values can be retrieved from the fitted model.

\###Information criteria and cross validation

``` r
data("GasolineYield",package="betareg")
set.seed(1)
bbb <- PLS_beta_kfoldcv_formula(yield~.,data=GasolineYield,nt=3,modele="pls-beta",verbose=FALSE)
kfolds2CVinfos_beta(bbb)
#> ____************************************************____
#> 
#> Model: pls-beta 
#> 
#> Link: logit 
#> 
#> Link.phi: 
#> 
#> Type: ML 
#> 
#> ____Component____ 1 ____
#> ____Component____ 2 ____
#> ____Component____ 3 ____
#> ____Predicting X without NA neither in X or Y____
#> ****________________________________________________****
#> 
#> NK: 1
#> [[1]]
#>                  AIC        BIC Q2Chisqcum_Y
#> Nb_Comp_0  -52.77074  -49.83927           NA
#> Nb_Comp_1  -87.96104  -83.56383    -1.121431
#> Nb_Comp_2 -114.10269 -108.23975    -5.291744
#> Nb_Comp_3 -152.71170 -145.38302   -11.583916
#>            limQ2 Q2Chisq_Y PREChi2_Pearson_Y
#> Nb_Comp_0     NA        NA                NA
#> Nb_Comp_1 0.0975 -1.121431          65.17044
#> Nb_Comp_2 0.0975 -1.965802          92.87255
#> Nb_Comp_3 0.0975 -1.000068          66.13838
#>           Chi2_Pearson_Y      RSS_Y pseudo_R2_Y
#> Nb_Comp_0       30.72004 0.35640772          NA
#> Nb_Comp_1       31.31448 0.11172576   0.6879757
#> Nb_Comp_2       33.06807 0.04650238   0.8671800
#> Nb_Comp_3       30.69727 0.01138837   0.9526757
#>                R2_Y
#> Nb_Comp_0        NA
#> Nb_Comp_1 0.6865226
#> Nb_Comp_2 0.8695248
#> Nb_Comp_3 0.9680468
```

\###Bootstrap of the coefficients

Computing bootstrap distributions

``` r
data("GasolineYield",package="betareg")
set.seed(1)
GazYield.boot <- bootplsbeta(modpls, sim="ordinary", stype="i", R=250)
```

Boxplots of the bootstrap distributions

``` r
plsRglm::boxplots.bootpls(GazYield.boot)
```

![plot of chunk
bootboxplots](reference/figures/README-bootboxplots-1.png)

plot of chunk bootboxplots

Confidence intervals for the coefficients of the model based on the
bootstrap distributions

``` r
plsRglm::confints.bootpls(GazYield.boot)
#>                                                                                                             
#> Intercept -1.796887447 -1.298797470 -1.79109655 -1.32785762 -1.77750018 -1.31426124 -1.75724986 -1.263641413
```

on the bootstrap distributions

``` r
plsRglm::plots.confints.bootpls(plsRglm::confints.bootpls(GazYield.boot))
```

# Package index

## All functions

- [`PLS_beta()`](https://fbertran.github.io/plsRbeta/reference/PLS_beta.md)
  : Partial least squares beta regression models
- [`PLS_beta_formula()`](https://fbertran.github.io/plsRbeta/reference/PLS_beta_formula.md)
  : Partial least squares beta regression models
- [`PLS_beta_kfoldcv()`](https://fbertran.github.io/plsRbeta/reference/PLS_beta_kfoldcv.md)
  : Partial least squares regression beta models with kfold cross
  validation
- [`PLS_beta_kfoldcv_formula()`](https://fbertran.github.io/plsRbeta/reference/PLS_beta_kfoldcv_formula.md)
  : Partial least squares regression beta models with kfold cross
  validation
- [`PLS_beta_wvc()`](https://fbertran.github.io/plsRbeta/reference/PLS_beta_wvc.md)
  : Light version of PLS_beta for cross validation purposes
- [`TxTum`](https://fbertran.github.io/plsRbeta/reference/TxTum.md) :
  Cancer infiltration rates
- [`TxTum.mod.bootBC1`](https://fbertran.github.io/plsRbeta/reference/TxTum.mod.bootBC1.md)
  : Bootstrap distribution TxTum BC1 model
- [`TxTum.mod.bootBR6`](https://fbertran.github.io/plsRbeta/reference/TxTum.mod.bootBR6.md)
  : Bootstrap distribution TxTum BR6 model
- [`bootplsbeta()`](https://fbertran.github.io/plsRbeta/reference/bootplsbeta.md)
  : Non-parametric Bootstrap for PLS beta regression models
- [`coefs.plsRbeta()`](https://fbertran.github.io/plsRbeta/reference/coefs.plsRbeta.md)
  : Coefficients function for bootstrap techniques
- [`coefs.plsRbeta.raw()`](https://fbertran.github.io/plsRbeta/reference/coefs.plsRbeta.raw.md)
  : Raw coefficients function for bootstrap techniques
- [`coefs.plsRbetanp()`](https://fbertran.github.io/plsRbeta/reference/coefs.plsRbetanp.md)
  : Coefficients for bootstrap computations of PLSBeta models
- [`colon`](https://fbertran.github.io/plsRbeta/reference/colon.md) :
  Tumor rate and spectral data
- [`ind_BCa_nt1BC`](https://fbertran.github.io/plsRbeta/reference/ind_BCa_nt1BC.md)
  : ind_BCa_nt1BC
- [`ind_BCa_nt1BR`](https://fbertran.github.io/plsRbeta/reference/ind_BCa_nt1BR.md)
  : ind_BCa_nt1BR
- [`ind_BCa_nt2BC`](https://fbertran.github.io/plsRbeta/reference/ind_BCa_nt2BC.md)
  : ind_BCa_nt2BC
- [`ind_BCa_nt2BR`](https://fbertran.github.io/plsRbeta/reference/ind_BCa_nt2BR.md)
  : ind_BCa_nt2BR
- [`ind_BCa_nt3`](https://fbertran.github.io/plsRbeta/reference/ind_BCa_nt3.md)
  : ind_BCa_nt3
- [`ind_BCa_nt3BC`](https://fbertran.github.io/plsRbeta/reference/ind_BCa_nt3BC.md)
  : ind_BCa_nt3BC
- [`ind_BCa_nt3BR`](https://fbertran.github.io/plsRbeta/reference/ind_BCa_nt3BR.md)
  : ind_BCa_nt3BR
- [`ind_BCa_nt4BC`](https://fbertran.github.io/plsRbeta/reference/ind_BCa_nt4BC.md)
  : ind_BCa_nt4BC
- [`ind_BCa_nt4BR`](https://fbertran.github.io/plsRbeta/reference/ind_BCa_nt4BR.md)
  : ind_BCa_nt4BR
- [`ind_BCa_nt5BC`](https://fbertran.github.io/plsRbeta/reference/ind_BCa_nt5BC.md)
  : ind_BCa_nt5BC
- [`ind_BCa_nt5BR`](https://fbertran.github.io/plsRbeta/reference/ind_BCa_nt5BR.md)
  : ind_BCa_nt5BR
- [`ind_BCa_nt6BC`](https://fbertran.github.io/plsRbeta/reference/ind_BCa_nt6BC.md)
  : ind_BCa_nt6BC
- [`ind_BCa_nt6BR`](https://fbertran.github.io/plsRbeta/reference/ind_BCa_nt6BR.md)
  : ind_BCa_nt6BR
- [`kfolds2CVinfos_beta()`](https://fbertran.github.io/plsRbeta/reference/kfolds2CVinfos_beta.md)
  : Extracts and computes information criteria and fits statistics for
  kfold cross validated partial least squares beta regression models
- [`kfolds2Chisq()`](https://fbertran.github.io/plsRbeta/reference/kfolds2Chisq.md)
  : Computes Predicted Chisquare for kfold cross validated partial least
  squares beta regression models.
- [`kfolds2Chisqind()`](https://fbertran.github.io/plsRbeta/reference/kfolds2Chisqind.md)
  : Computes individual Predicted Chisquare for kfold cross validated
  partial least squares beta regression models.
- [`modpls.boot3`](https://fbertran.github.io/plsRbeta/reference/modpls.boot3.md)
  : Bootstrap distribution of a 3 components model
- [`modpls_sub4`](https://fbertran.github.io/plsRbeta/reference/modpls_sub4.md)
  : A plsRbetamodel model on a data subset
- [`permcoefs.plsRbeta()`](https://fbertran.github.io/plsRbeta/reference/permcoefs.plsRbeta.md)
  : Coefficients function for permutation bootstrap techniques
- [`permcoefs.plsRbeta.raw()`](https://fbertran.github.io/plsRbeta/reference/permcoefs.plsRbeta.raw.md)
  : Raw coefficients function for permutation bootstrap techniques
- [`permcoefs.plsRbetanp()`](https://fbertran.github.io/plsRbeta/reference/permcoefs.plsRbetanp.md)
  : Coefficients for permutation bootstrap computations of PLSBeta
  models
- [`plsRbeta()`](https://fbertran.github.io/plsRbeta/reference/plsRbeta.md)
  [`plsRbetamodel()`](https://fbertran.github.io/plsRbeta/reference/plsRbeta.md)
  : Partial least squares Regression beta regression models
- [`predict.plsRbetamodel()`](https://fbertran.github.io/plsRbeta/reference/predict.plsRbetamodel.md)
  : Predict method for plsRbeta models
- [`print(`*`<plsRbetamodel>`*`)`](https://fbertran.github.io/plsRbeta/reference/print.plsRbetamodel.md)
  : Print method for plsRbeta models
- [`print(`*`<summary.plsRbetamodel>`*`)`](https://fbertran.github.io/plsRbeta/reference/print.summary.plsRbetamodel.md)
  : Print method for summaries of plsRbeta models
- [`simul_data_UniYX_beta()`](https://fbertran.github.io/plsRbeta/reference/simul_data_UniYX_beta.md)
  : Data generating function for univariate beta plsR models
- [`summary(`*`<plsRbetamodel>`*`)`](https://fbertran.github.io/plsRbeta/reference/summary.plsRbetamodel.md)
  : Summary method for plsRbeta models
- [`tilt.bootplsbeta()`](https://fbertran.github.io/plsRbeta/reference/tilt.bootplsbeta.md)
  : Non-parametric tilted bootstrap for PLS beta regression models

# Articles

### All vignettes

- [Partial Least Squares Regression for Beta Regression
  Models](https://fbertran.github.io/plsRbeta/articles/tn_Insights.md):
